An '''unidentified cook''' worked for the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime boss]] known as [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After Valarian [[Death/Legends|killed]] her husband [[D'Wopp]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the body was shipped to [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toola/Legends|Toola]] in a box, with several parts missing. The cook was the only other person, with Valarian herself, to know where the missing body parts had gone.
